title: Minimal flow contract and aggregate-surplus obstruction
mathematical_status: proved route obstruction; actual bridge open

flow_system.left_objects: Seed-demand types i, split into d_i indistinguishable unit tokens when d_i>1.
flow_system.right_objects: Legal rank slots j before rank 42 with effective integral capacity C_j=C_j^raw-beta_j after borrow reservations beta_j.
flow_system.incidence: An edge i~j means the exact Macaulay transition, cap depth, and borrow state permit seed type i to exit at rank slot j.
flow_system.variables: f_ij in Z_{>=0} on legal edges.
constraints: sum_(j in N(i)) f_ij = d_i for every demand type i
sum_i f_ij <= C_j for every legal rank slot j
f_ij=0 whenever the exact borrow/cap transition forbids i~j
flow_system.hall_equivalent: After splitting demands and capacities into unit copies, feasibility is equivalent to |X|<=sum_(j in N(X))C_j for every set X of demand tokens.

information_missing: which demand token can use which rank slot
rankwise capacities after earlier seed choices
borrow reservations beta_j and collisions between seed types
relation_to_relaxed_gamma4.conclusion: Uniform gamma4>0 can at most certify an aggregate/full-set capacity inequality after an additional identification theorem. It cannot by itself imply the proper-subset Hall cuts.

inherited_interface_mismatch.actual_rank42_gate: The inherited public-problem route asks for E_42<binom(M,42). Its proved propagation input is one adjacent-parameter diagonal surplus Gamma_r=g_(r+1)-S_r(f_r)>=0 before the endpoint.
inherited_interface_mismatch.relaxed_result: The new uniform theorem proves gamma4=U_3(y)-U_3(x)-z-1>0 for individual admissible relaxed no-borrow states parameterized by (q,c,r,u).
inherited_interface_mismatch.missing_identification: No inherited theorem maps every required adjacent orbit pair (f^M,f^(M+1)) to one of these relaxed states while preserving borrow legality, nor identifies gamma4 with Gamma_r or with the full-set capacity of a rank-slot flow network.
inherited_interface_mismatch.consequence: The proposed Hall system is the minimum data structure an actual bridge would have to construct, not an already proved reformulation of E_42<binom(M,42). There are two obligations before Hall can help: derive the token-slot incidence from the Macaulay orbit, then prove its proper cut inequalities.

audited_minimum_gamma_anchor.source_status: This is the minimum-gamma4 row in the previously independently audited finite census; the present guard recomputes it directly.

abstract_nonidentifiability_certificate.aggregate_data: two unit demands, three unit-capacity rank slots, total surplus one
abstract_nonidentifiability_certificate.infeasible_completion: N(i_1)=N(i_2)={j_1}; the cut {i_1,i_2} has demand 2 and neighbourhood capacity 1
abstract_nonidentifiability_certificate.force: Both completions have identical relaxed parameters and identical aggregate capacity. Therefore no argument using only gamma4 or the tuple (q,c,r,u,b,h,x,y) can determine Hall feasibility.
abstract_nonidentifiability_certificate.scope_firewall: The infeasible completion is an abstract information-loss witness, not a realized Boolean-lattice counterexample and not a counterexample to Erdős #776.

required_new_statistic.full_form: The borrow-aware neighbourhood-capacity profile kappa(X)=sum_(j in N(X))(C_j^raw-beta_j) for demand-token subsets X.
required_new_statistic.compressed_target: Prove that exact legal rank sets are intervals or form a laminar family. Then retain, for every rank interval I subseteq {4,...,42}, the trapped demand D(I)=sum_{i:N(i) subseteq I}d_i and effective capacity C(I)=sum_{j in I}(C_j^raw-beta_j); the bridge reduces to D(I)<=C(I) for all critical intervals.
required_new_statistic.unproved_step: No inherited theorem shows interval/laminar accessibility or derives these cut inequalities from Macaulay surplus persistence.

bounded_guard.result: pass; exact gamma4=69 anchor reproduced, feasible network has no Hall-deficient subset, infeasible network has the two-token cut 2>1
bounded_guard.scope: exact recomputation of the relaxed anchor and exhaustive Hall cuts of the two-token abstract networks

claim_effect: Refutes the scalar relaxed-positive-to-Hall inference and specifies the minimum missing incidence statistic. It does not refute the enriched M12 capacity-flow mechanism.
